_comment: Committed on purpose: this is scope, not a secret. Secrets live in .env.
Asset classes use this system's own vocabulary - 'stock'/'stock_option' -
not addendum 39's EQUITIES/OPTIONS_ON_EQUITIES labels. The spec's reason for
insisting on OPTIONS_ON_EQUITIES over a generic OPTIONS (options on other
underlyings are coming) is already satisfied here, more finely: stock_option,
etf_option and future_option have always been separate codes. See
docs/SPEC_RECONCILIATION.md §70 disposition 2. Loaded and validated by
backend/boot_config.py, which refuses any class reference_data.py does not know.
